as_told.title: Admiral Byrd's statement to the Chilean press

related.note: Both are about Byrd and Operation Highjump. Dolan reads Byrd's statement as not being about flying saucers, while the story claims the fleet met laser-shooting discs.

plain: This story is about Operation Highjump, a US Navy expedition to Antarctica in 1946 and 1947, and something Admiral Richard Byrd said afterwards. A researcher, Jason Jorjani, says that when Byrd reached a port in Chile he told the Chilean press that America needed to prepare for a third world war, in which aircraft could fly from pole to pole at tremendous speed. Some people read that as a hint that Byrd met strange flying craft in Antarctica, and a related version even speaks of discs shooting lasers. Another researcher, Richard Dolan, tells it differently. He says he read Byrd's full statement and does not think Byrd was really talking about flying saucers. So the two agree there was a statement but disagree on what it meant.
